notes: 'Did not your fathers thus' elides the English 'do', so the first 'Did' is read as עָשׂוּ's own rendering and הֲ takes the distributed 'did' of the coordinated clause (rule 25); the competing reading (both auxiliaries to הֲ, עָשׂוּ unrepresented) is named in the unit note and remains defensible.
